subject: Christopher Nolan
headline: nolan's odyssey has gen z listening to homer
body: the universal pictures release is already breaking box office records worldwide.
slide2: $264 million worldwide, raves from critics, and early oscar buzz — the phenomenon now has gen z turning to homer's original text too.

subject: Justin Bieber
headline: bieber's weird world cup song spiked 240%
body: he shared the world cup halftime stage with a few other pretty big names.
slide2: shakira, madonna, bts, robbie williams and jennifer hudson also performed, with kylie jenner and timothée chalamet watching from the crowd.

subject: Chloe Fineman
headline: chloe fineman found her next job days after leaving snl
body: she's joining a new netflix drama in a series regular role.
slide2: she'll star opposite jabari banks — his first major role since bel-air — in netflix's myron bolitar, alongside jamie mcshane and ben mckenzie.

subject: Ryan Reynolds
headline: ryan reynolds confirms a new deadpool movie is coming
slide2: he made the announcement at fanatics fest 2026. the film is in early development with no writer or director attached yet.
